  // 8 RhandX, 9 RhandY, 10 RanchorX, 11 RanchorY,
  // 12 RhandScale, 13 LhandRot, 14 RhandRot
  var P = [
    [-1,    0,  0,   0,  70,  88, 65, 133, 212,  80, 208, 134, 1.00,   0,   0], // 0
    [-4.5, -1, -2, -12,  17,  72, 62, 112, 157, 100, 192, 142, 1.10, -20, -15], // 160
    [-3,    8,  0,   4,  55, 105, 60, 147, 212, 100, 212, 149, 1.00,   0,   0], // 340
    [-3.5,  8,  0,   2,  60,  99, 61, 145, 212,  96, 211, 147, 1.00,   0,   0], // 420 (brief settle before next swing)
    [-5,   11,  0,  -8,  22, 110, 62, 142, 187, 125, 203, 151, 1.08, -20, -10], // 500
    [ 2.5,  6,  0, -15,  22, 100, 65, 132, 167, 105, 198, 146, 1.10, -20, -15], // 680
    [-3,    0,  0,   0,  62,  95, 62, 139, 212,  92, 210, 139, 1.00,   0,   0], // 840
    [-5,    6,  0, -12,  17,  90, 62, 125, 165, 108, 198, 148, 1.10, -20, -15], // 1020
    [ 1,    8,  0,   4,  55, 115, 60, 148, 210, 108, 212, 150, 1.00,   0,   0]  // 1180
  ];
  P.push(P[0]);

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  var elBody = $('body'),
      elBelly = $('belly'),
      elShade = $('body-shade-left'),
      elHead = $('head'),
      elArmL = $('arm-left-shape'),
      elArmLLit = $('arm-left-lit'),
      elHandL = $('hand-left'),
      elArmR = $('arm-right-shape'),
      elHandR = $('hand-right');

  function f(v) { return v.toFixed(2); }

  // tapered capsule from anchor (ax,ay; radius r2) to hand (hx,hy; radius r1)
  function armPath(ax, ay, hx, hy, r1, r2) {
    var dx = hx - ax, dy = hy - ay, L = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (L < 0.01) { dx = 0; dy = -1; L = 1; }
    dx /= L; dy /= L;
    var nx = -dy, ny = dx;
    return 'M' + f(ax + nx * r2) + ' ' + f(ay + ny * r2) +
           ' L' + f(hx + nx * r1) + ' ' + f(hy + ny * r1) +
           ' A' + r1 + ' ' + r1 + ' 0 0 0 ' + f(hx - nx * r1) + ' ' + f(hy - ny * r1) +
           ' L' + f(ax - nx * r2) + ' ' + f(ay - ny * r2) +
           ' A' + r2 + ' ' + r2 + ' 0 0 0 ' + f(ax + nx * r2) + ' ' + f(ay + ny * r2) + ' Z';
  }

  function render(t) {
    t = +t;
    if (!isFinite(t)) t = 0;
    t = ((t % PERIOD) + PERIOD) % PERIOD;

    var i = 0;
    while (i < T.length - 2 && t >= T[i + 1]) i++;
    var u = (t - T[i]) / (T[i + 1] - T[i]);
    if (u < 0) u = 0; else if (u > 1) u = 1;
    var e = u * u * (3 - 2 * u);

    var a = P[i], b = P[i + 1], p = [];
    for (var j = 0; j < a.length; j++) p[j] = a[j] + (b[j] - a[j]) * e;

    var headX = p[0], headY = p[1], headRot = p[2], bellyX = p[3];

    // body: squash vertically about the floor, lean with the head
    var yb = 230, cx = 126, neckSpan = 164;
    var sy = 1 - headY / neckSpan;
    var sx = 1 + 0.003 * headY;
    var k = headX / neckSpan;
    var me = cx - sx * cx + k * yb;
    var mf = yb - sy * yb;
    elBody.setAttribute('transform',
      'matrix(' + sx.toFixed(4) + ' 0 ' + (-k).toFixed(4) + ' ' + sy.toFixed(4) + ' ' + f(me) + ' ' + f(mf) + ')');
    elBelly.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + f(bellyX) + ' 0)');

    // head
    elHead.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(' + f(headX) + ' ' + f(headY) + ') rotate(' + f(headRot) + ' 126 60)');

    // left arm
    var dL = armPath(p[6], p[7], p[4], p[5], 13, 19);
    elArmL.setAttribute('d', dL);
    elArmLLit.setAttribute('d', dL);
    var lit = (52 - p[4]) / 25;
    if (lit < 0) lit = 0; else if (lit > 1) lit = 1;
    elArmLLit.setAttribute('opacity', lit.toFixed(3));
    elShade.setAttribute('opacity', (lit * 0.85).toFixed(3));
    elHandL.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(' + f(p[4]) + ' ' + f(p[5]) + ') rotate(' + f(p[13]) + ')');

    // right arm
    elArmR.setAttribute('d', armPath(p[10], p[11], p[8], p[9], 14, 18));
    elHandR.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(' + f(p[8]) + ' ' + f(p[9]) + ') rotate(' + f(p[14]) + ') scale(' + p[12].toFixed(3) + ')');
  }

  window.nwb = { render: render };
  render(0);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
